_doc: Declared amendments to pre-registered files. A frozen file may differ from its pre-registration only by an entry here naming the file, the pre-registration commit, its git blob there (from_blob) and its git blob now (to_blob), signed. Read by scripts/rob2_ni_score.declared.

amendments.what: (a) git output decoded as UTF-8 whatever the locale (the 12 Oct false refusal: U+202F read as cp1252); (b) this declared-amendment check itself. No comparison or scoring logic changes.
amendments.evidence: outputs/robgrade/NI_SCORE_RUN.md; tests/test_rob2_ni_score_amendment.py (real git: 5 failing on the pre-registered scorer, passing on this one). The amended scorer, run WITHOUT UTF-8 mode, reproduces NI_SCORE.md and ni_score.json byte for byte.
